Function: Praised as the "mightiest of the mighty", deity associated with storms and destructive forces, Rudra is sometimes considered a fearsome and powerful aspect of Lord Shiva
Interests: While associated with destruction, Rudra is also a healer and a purifier. Destroyer and Transformer: Rudra is often recognized as the destructive and transformative aspect of the divine trinity in Hinduism, alongside Brahma (the Creator) and Vishnu (the Preserver). As the destroyer, Rudra facilitates the process of dissolution, making way for regeneration and new creation.
Symbolism: storms, such as lightning and the drum (damaru)
Values: Rudra is considered a form of Lord Shiva

Values: Shakti and Shiva Unity: The union of Rudra (Shiva) and Rudrani (Parvati) symbolizes the unity of Shakti (divine feminine energy) and Shiva (divine masculine energy)
